status: Partial mitigation; broader asynchronous pipeline/painter-state race remains open.
change: Round periodic request intervals upward. A configured 60 FPS previously used 16 ms (up to 62.5 requests/s); it now uses 17 ms. Wide arithmetic handles malformed and extreme FPS without overflow. This is a maximum periodic request rate, not exact fractional cadence or a cap on ready-event submissions.
regression: Permanent normal-suite host/tests/evdi_helper.rs::t750_periodic_requests_never_round_above_configured_fps executes C test T750-period under UBSan. Exhaustive 1..240 FPS bounds, minimal non-overshooting integer period, INT_MIN/-1/0 fallback, INT_MAX. Test failed before production change and passes afterward; logs retained.
